hook.say: Think you know where Turkey sits on the map? Five quick questions. The last one fools almost everyone!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Türkiye lies on which two continents?
questions.say: Turkey lies on which two continents?
questions.fact: Most of Türkiye is in Asia; a small part, Thrace, is in Europe.
questions.sayAnswer: Europe and Asia! Most of Turkey is in Asia, and a small part, called Thrace, is in Europe.

questions.q: Which strait splits Istanbul between Europe and Asia?
questions.say: Which strait splits Istanbul between Europe and Asia?
questions.fact: The Bosphorus links the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara.
questions.sayAnswer: The Bosphorus! It links the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara.

questions.q: How many geographical regions is Türkiye divided into?
questions.say: How many geographical regions is Turkey divided into?
questions.fact: The seven regions were set by Türkiye's First Geography Congress.
questions.sayAnswer: Seven! The 7 regions were set by Turkey's First Geography Congress.

questions.q: How many countries share a land border with Türkiye?
questions.say: How many countries share a land border with Turkey?
questions.fact: Greece, Bulgaria, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Iran, Iraq and Syria.
questions.sayAnswer: Eight! Greece, Bulgaria, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Iran, Iraq and Syria.

questions.q: Which sea lies entirely inside Türkiye?
questions.say: Which sea lies entirely inside Turkey?
questions.fact: The Sea of Marmara connects the Black Sea and the Aegean.
questions.sayAnswer: The Sea of Marmara! It connects the Black Sea and the Aegean, and it is all Turkish.
